title: Salesforce Platform Developer I
goal: Pass the Salesforce Platform Developer I certification exam

exam.name: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
exam.verify_note: 2026-11-23: weights 27/28/25/20 are from Salesforce's Trailhead prep module for this exam. The full exam guide could not be read, so 60 questions, 105 minutes and the 68% pass mark are still unverified. Paste the official outline to verify.

concepts.title: Multitenancy and why governor limits exist
concepts.objective: Explain the multitenant architecture and how it shapes governor limits and development choices.

concepts.title: Declarative vs programmatic customization
concepts.objective: Choose between clicks (Flow, validation rules, formulas) and code for a given requirement.

concepts.title: Standard and custom objects, field types
concepts.objective: Pick the right field type, including formula and roll-up summary fields, for a data requirement.

concepts.title: Lookup, master-detail and junction relationships
concepts.objective: Model one-to-many and many-to-many relationships and know the ownership, sharing and deletion behavior of each.

concepts.title: Importing and exporting data
concepts.objective: Choose between Data Import Wizard and Data Loader, and use external IDs to relate records on import.

concepts.title: Apex data types, sObjects and collections
concepts.objective: Use primitives, sObjects, List, Set and Map correctly, including map-from-query idioms.

concepts.title: Apex classes, interfaces and access modifiers
concepts.objective: Write classes and interfaces; use static vs instance members, constructors, inheritance and access modifiers.

concepts.title: SOQL queries and relationship queries
concepts.objective: Write SOQL with filters, ordering, limits, and parent-to-child and child-to-parent relationship queries.

concepts.title: Aggregates, bind variables and dynamic SOQL
concepts.objective: Use aggregate functions and bind variables, and build dynamic SOQL safely against injection.

concepts.title: SOSL search and when to use it over SOQL
concepts.objective: Decide between SOSL and SOQL and read SOSL results across multiple objects.

concepts.title: DML statements and Database class methods
concepts.objective: Insert, update, upsert (with external IDs), delete and undelete; use Database methods with allOrNone and SaveResult.

concepts.title: Flow types and when to use them
concepts.objective: Choose record-triggered (before/after save), screen, scheduled and autolaunched flows for a requirement.

concepts.title: Apex triggers: events and context variables
concepts.objective: Use before/after events and Trigger.new, old, newMap, oldMap and the isInsert/isUpdate flags correctly.

concepts.title: Writing code within governor limits
concepts.objective: Avoid SOQL and DML inside loops, read the Limits class, and know the key per-transaction limits.

concepts.title: Bulkified triggers and the handler pattern
concepts.objective: Write triggers that handle 200 records per batch, one trigger per object with logic in a handler class.

concepts.title: Save order of execution
concepts.objective: Predict the order of validation rules, before-save flows, triggers, workflow-era automation and commits on save.

concepts.title: Exception handling and addError
concepts.objective: Use try/catch/finally, custom exceptions and addError to stop or surface failures correctly.

concepts.title: Transactions, savepoints and recursion control
concepts.objective: Reason about transaction boundaries, use Savepoint and rollback, and prevent trigger recursion with static state.

concepts.title: with sharing, without sharing, inherited sharing
concepts.objective: Pick the sharing keyword for a class and predict which records a query returns.

concepts.title: Enforcing object and field security in Apex
concepts.objective: Enforce CRUD and FLS with user-mode queries and DML, WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED and Security.stripInaccessible.

concepts.title: Future methods
concepts.objective: Use @future (including callout=true) and know its parameter and chaining restrictions.

concepts.title: Queueable Apex
concepts.objective: Use Queueable for non-primitive state and chaining, and monitor jobs with AsyncApexJob.

concepts.title: Batch Apex
concepts.objective: Implement start/execute/finish, choose a scope size, and use Database.Stateful when state must carry over.

concepts.title: Scheduled Apex
concepts.objective: Schedule jobs with cron expressions and launch batch jobs from a Schedulable class.

concepts.title: Calling Apex from Flow with invocable methods
concepts.objective: Expose bulk-safe @InvocableMethod and @InvocableVariable to Flow.

concepts.title: Custom metadata types and custom settings
concepts.objective: Store configuration in custom metadata or custom settings instead of hard-coding, and know which deploys with metadata.

concepts.title: Platform events
concepts.objective: Publish and subscribe to platform events from Apex, triggers and Flow, and know publish-immediately vs after-commit.

concepts.title: Lightning Web Component structure and decorators
concepts.objective: Build a component's HTML, JS and meta files, use @api, @track and @wire, and the lifecycle hooks.

concepts.title: Getting data into LWC: LDS, wire adapters, Apex
concepts.objective: Choose Lightning Data Service, wire adapters or imperative Apex (@AuraEnabled cacheable) and handle errors.

concepts.title: Component communication and Lightning Message Service
concepts.objective: Pass data down with public properties, up with custom events, and across the page with Lightning Message Service.

concepts.title: Exposing components to App Builder, Experience Cloud and Flow
concepts.objective: Configure targets and design attributes in the meta XML so admins can place components.

concepts.title: Aura components and how they coexist with LWC
concepts.objective: Know when Aura is still needed and how Aura and LWC compose.

concepts.title: Visualforce pages and controllers
concepts.objective: Use standard controllers, extensions and custom controllers, and know when Visualforce is the right tool.

concepts.title: Preventing XSS and injection in UI code
concepts.objective: Escape output in Visualforce, rely on Lightning Web Security and Locker, and avoid SOQL injection from UI input.

concepts.title: Apex test classes, assertions and coverage
concepts.objective: Write @isTest classes with meaningful assertions, know the 75% coverage rule and test data isolation (SeeAllData).

concepts.title: Test data factories and @testSetup
concepts.objective: Create data with factory classes, @testSetup and Test.loadData.

concepts.title: Test.startTest/stopTest and testing async code
concepts.objective: Use startTest/stopTest to reset limits and force async work to complete before assertions.

concepts.title: System.runAs and callout mocks
concepts.objective: Test sharing and permissions with runAs, and callouts with HttpCalloutMock and Test.setMock.

concepts.title: Testing Lightning Web Components with Jest
concepts.objective: Know what Jest tests cover for LWC and how wire adapters and Apex are mocked.

concepts.title: Debug logs, Developer Console and the Replay Debugger
concepts.objective: Set trace flags and log levels, read a debug log, and use checkpoints and the Apex Replay Debugger.

concepts.title: Sandboxes, scratch orgs and development environments
concepts.objective: Choose the sandbox type or scratch org for a task and know what each copies.

concepts.title: Deploying: change sets, Salesforce CLI and packages
concepts.objective: Deploy with change sets, the Salesforce CLI and Metadata API, or unlocked packages, and know the test requirements for production.
